Enabling extract_images processes a data-URI image without crashing

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Before<img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==" alt="pixel">After</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_images: true))
puts result.content.inspect
```
